title: SlopSwipe: Skip AI Slop Videos
shortDescription: Auto-swipe past AI junk as you scroll. Content filter, block list, one-tap undo.
tagline: Skip AI Slop in Shorts, TikTok and Reels

sections.title: Skip AI Slop in Shorts, TikTok and Reels
paragraphs: AI-generated slop is flooding short-video feeds: AI voiceover stories, fake animals, synthetic "news". SlopSwipe is an automatic AI video filter for Android. Keep using the real YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels apps; when a video matches a rule you turned on, SlopSwipe swipes to the next one and records why, so a wrong skip is easy to undo. Nothing from your screen leaves your phone, and no account is needed. It needs Android's accessibility service, which you turn on once in system settings.

sections.title: Popular Ways People Use SlopSwipe
bullets: Clean up a feed overrun by AI slop without quitting short videos
Block AI content farms and spam accounts by name so they never come back
Give a parent or grandparent a feed with fewer fake videos

sections.title: AI Video Detection by Transparent Rules
bullets: Platform AI labels: videos marked as AI-generated are skipped
AI keywords: AI hashtags or phrases in the title or caption
Your own block list, plus a shared list of AI accounts that users report and a person reviews
Every rule is visible in Settings and can be switched off

sections.title: Auto Swipe, Hint Bar and One-Tap Undo
bullets: Auto-swipes to the next video when a rule matches, with a tunable delay
History shows why each video was skipped; mark a mistake there, or turn on an Undo button after every skip
Allow list for creators you trust, block list for accounts you are done with
Three sensitivity levels: Strict (default), Normal, Relaxed; light AI like AI voiceover is skipped too, or set it to Hint or Ignore
Never acts on ads, comments, messages or any other app

sections.title: Schedule, Parent Mode, Widget and Rule Packs
bullets: Optional: report AI accounts anonymously; a person reviews every report
Schedule stricter filtering at night or during work hours
Parent mode locks the settings behind a PIN
Home-screen widget with today's skips, Quick Settings tile to pause
Themed rule packs; pause for 30 minutes, until tomorrow or until you resume

sections.title: Screen Time and Digital Wellbeing
bullets: See how long you scroll and how many AI videos were skipped today and this week
Daily limit, bedtime and focus time with a gentle reminder or a trip to the home screen
Every limit has "Off for today"; nothing is forced on you

sections.title: Guides That Work Without Any Permission
paragraphs: Guides show how to reduce AI videos with each platform's own settings, how to spot AI videos yourself, and how to keep the service alive on phones with aggressive battery savers.

sections.title: Privacy First, On-Device Only
bullets: Reads only on-screen text in Shorts, TikTok and Reels: title, caption, account name, hashtags, AI label
No screen recording, no screenshots, no upload of screen content, no login
The "What we read" page shows exactly what was read last; crash reports and statistics are optional
No ads, no subscriptions

sections.title: Please note
bullets: SlopSwipe uses Android's accessibility service to read on-screen text and swipe up for you. It is not an assistive tool for people with disabilities, explains what it does before you turn it on, and works only after you agree.
Instagram Reels is off by default in this first version; turn it on under Settings → Where it works.

Detection relies on labels, text and lists: unlabelled videos may slip through and a wrong one may occasionally be skipped; Undo fixes that. If a platform update changes the layout, SlopSwipe stops acting and tells you. Requires Android 8.0+.
YouTube, TikTok and Instagram are trademarks of their owners. SlopSwipe is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

sections.title: Something not working?
paragraphs: If a video was not skipped, or the wrong one was, email feedback@dapplebyte.com before leaving a review. Tell us your phone model and the platform; most issues are fixed in the next update.
